phase: Phase 5: Quality Gates, Documentation, and Closeout
summary: All Wave 0 acceptance criteria are met. PROJECT_LINT (exit 0), PROJECT_CHECKS (exit 0), and PROJECT_TESTS (exit 0 with --concurrency=1 and, in isolation, with --force per package) all pass at HEAD 50569fb0. The db test gate that was previously RED in the prior 2026-06-29 acceptance now genuinely passes with 638 passed / 6 skipped after commit 30d2749a (`fix(db): migration surface and test sync`) reconciled the vitest config, schema counts, role guards, migration allowlist/journal, and marketing-schema expectations. Anti-pattern audit (A1, A5, A6, A9) is clean. Two non-blocking observations are recorded: (1) an unrelated worktree modification to measure/tech-debt.md (from a separate deployment-audit workstream, which instructions require preserving) inflates the file to 51 lines and would trip the auth phase-7-closeout 50-line cap test; this is orthogonal to Wave 0 and is not committed; (2) the db env-guards.test.ts FR-7 subprocess-spawn tests can flake under default turbo parallelism because Vitest's 5s testTimeout is tight for `spawn(node)` when other packages compete for CPU; they pass deterministically with --concurrency=1 and when the db package is run alone. This is a pre-existing db_migration_ledger_20260611 infra issue, not a Wave 0 regression.

findings.title: db env-guards subprocess-spawn timeouts under default turbo parallelism
findings.detail: packages/db/src/__tests__/env-guards.test.ts (4 tests) and one test in drizzle045-schema-compile.test.ts spawn `node --input-type=module` subprocesses to verify FR-7 client.ts/privileged.ts runtime guards. Under default turbo parallel execution (5+ concurrent package test tasks), Vitest's 5s testTimeout can elapse before the spawned Node process finishes importing the compiled dist module. The tests pass deterministically when db runs alone (`pnpm turbo run test --filter=@reading-advantage/db --force`: 638/6-skip, exit 0) and at --concurrency=1 across all 5 packages (exit 0). This flake is inherited from the db_migration_ledger_20260611 FR-7 test infrastructure; it is not introduced by Wave 0. Recommended follow-up (Wave 2 candidate): raise testTimeout on env-guards subprocess tests to 20s or gate them behind a serial vitest project.
